paragraphs: Rav Yitzchak, son of Rabbah bar bar Chana.

He lived in Rava’s time. In Sukkah 43b Rava says to him: “Son of a lion, come and I will tell you a fine teaching your father used to say.” He died before Abaye: Yevamot 64b relates that he married Chuma, daughter of Issi son of Rav Yitzchak son of Rav Yehudah, after her husband Rachava of Pumbedita died. He too died, and Abaye married her. He is not Rav Yitzchak bar bar Chana, as explained in that entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The sequence is Rachava, then this Rav Yitzchak, then Abaye as Chuma’s husbands. Hyman explicitly distinguishes this Yitzchak from Yitzchak bar bar Chana.
“Son of a lion” translates בר אוריא. The marriage sequence is Hyman’s basis for inferring that this Yitzchak died before Abaye; the other Yitzchak remains distinct.
